A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research, renamed from NN-ResDMD to ResKoopNet. All 22 pages of each version, including equations, figures and appendices, support comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original pendulum simulations, turbulence-data analysis and neural-state clustering experiments, including supplementary results in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original simulations and data-analysis results in Section 4 and the appendices.

M1.justification: The spectral-residual objective, regularized Koopman-matrix update, alternating optimization, neural architecture, fixed dictionary outputs and pseudospectrum procedure remain unchanged. The new name and discussion of alternative optimizers do not establish a changed method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate pendulum spectral approximation, airfoil turbulence patterns and neural-state identification using Sensorium 2023 mouse recordings. No dataset, population or task scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Figure 4 retains EDMD, EDMD-DL, Hankel-DMD and ResDMD. The neural comparisons retain Hankel-DMD, EDMD with RBF basis and Kernel ResDMD; the appendix turbulence comparison is also retained. Newly cited methods such as SDMD are not evaluated as additional baselines.

E3.justification: The pendulum initial-state counts, trajectory lengths and step size remain unchanged, as do neural preprocessing, dictionary sizes, delay settings and clustering procedures. v2 supplies additional pendulum setup explanations without establishing a changed experimental protocol.

E4.justification: The dictionary-size comparisons in Figures 2–3 and alternative UMAP/t-SNE clustering analyses in Figures 8–11 are retained. No new ablation, sensitivity test, robustness experiment or error analysis appears.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same trial information and per-mouse DBI reporting. Neither adds training-run or seed information, confidence intervals, error bars or statistical significance tests.

E6.justification: The plotted results and reported findings are retained after matching renamed methods and resized figures. These include pendulum spectrum coverage using 300 and 350 observables, the turbulence modes and residuals, and the neural clustering results and DBI rankings.

T1.justification: The residual identities, optimization derivations and Barron-space theorem in Appendices A.1–A.3 remain mathematically unchanged. Equation (3.9) displays a pseudospectrum formula already given inline in v1; expanded normalization and adjoint notation are explanatory clarifications.

C1.justification: v2 explicitly frames the abstract and conclusion around mitigating spectral inclusion. Section 3.2 strengthens this framing by asserting that important spectral components are not omitted, beyond v1's emphasis on improving directly learned spectral estimates. The underlying contribution and application scope remain.

C2.justification: v2 removes the explicit caveat about difficulties establishing optimization convergence bounds and error estimates, and drops the stated limitation concerning highly noisy data. Computational cost, lack of stochastic modeling and hyperparameter sensitivity remain; the real-time limitation survives in Appendix A.5.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 newly states the pendulum equation and assigns dictionary families to the state variables. The source-code disclosure moves from A.9 to A.6, changes the anonymous repository target, and removes the promise of a full release upon acceptance. Actual repository availability cannot be established from the PDFs.

R1.justification: v2 adds references on stochastic Koopman estimation, rigged-RKHS observables and Takens' theorem, while removing several DMD and neural-Koopman citations, including mpEDMD and piDMD. It adds an SDMD comparison in the limitations discussion and explicitly connects alternating optimization to EDMD-DL, while retaining the main ResDMD/VAMP positioning.

P1.justification: The abstract and substantial portions of Sections 2–5 are rewritten or condensed, terminology changes throughout, and the conclusion is consolidated. The source-code appendix is reordered and subsequent appendices renumbered. This is extensive narrative editing beyond the method rename.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is restyled and recaptioned; Figures 2–4 are reduced and relocated; Figure 5 changes from one row to larger, labeled 2-by-2 panels; and Figure 6 is enlarged. Figure titles and legends adopt the new method name, while the figure set and underlying visual evidence remain.

improvement.justification: Larger turbulence panels, a consolidated conclusion and added pendulum details improve accessibility. However, v2 strengthens spectral-completeness assurances without additional theory or experiments, removes the optimization-convergence caveat, and introduces duplicated algorithm wording and additional unresolved author placeholders. These opposing changes leave the net effect on overall quality unclear.
